Name: Elle's Old Coop Animals
Author: junimods
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/n4XdwZb.png[/img]﻿

- Several different skins for each coop animal to choose from!
      - 50 skins for all chicken types
      - 12 skins for ducks
      - 40 skins for rabbits
      - 13 skins for dinosaurs
- Replacement of the icons in Marnie's shop
- Replacements for rabbit feet and duck feathers (change with your Rabbit and Duck configs)
- The ability to disable any animal replacement in the config.json for compatibility with other mods

﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/ad9prRZ.png[/img]﻿

[b][color=#e69138]1[/color][/b]. Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿.
[b][color=#e69138]2[/color][/b]. Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿.
[b][color=#e69138]3[/color][/b]. Extract into your \Stardew Valley\Mods\ folder.
[b][color=#e69138]4[/color][/b]. Run the game through SMAPI to generate a config.json, then close.
[color=#e69138][b]5[/b][/color]. Open the config.json and use the images in the References folder to change each animal to the texture name you prefer! To disable a retexture, change its value to "False"
[color=#e69138][b]6[/b][/color]. Run the game using SMAPI!

To uninstall, just delete the folder you put in your Mods directory.

[b][color=#e69138]Optional[/color][/b]: I have also included an optional folder of skins for use with the [u][color=#e69138][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4011]Adopt 'n Skin[/url][/color][/u] mod! This will let you use more variants of animals on your farm, including cats and dogs. Note that if you use A&S, you should only use the skins, not the main download.

To use, extract the skins folder into Adopt 'n Skin's assets folder and merge it. I have included all skins shown here; simply delete the ones you don't want to use! The chicken skins are separated by model instead of all being included for every chicken type.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/hxvaHeU.png[/img]﻿

1.1.2 - Added optional rabbit foot and duck feather replacements (enabled by default, change with your Rabbit and Duck configs)
          - Updated dinosaur sleeping sprites to be cuter
1.1.1 - Updated duck/baby chicken sprites for 1.5
          - Added "Golden" as an option for all chickens, replaces new Golden Chicken by default
          - Made sure all sprites sleep at night
1.1.0 - Changed mod to a single download with a config.json
          - Updated all sprites to match the rendering style of my newer mods
          - Added the ability to disable any animal retexture by changing its config to "False"
          - Added the ability to change any chicken type to any chicken texture (ie white chickens can now use blue or void chicken textures, etc)
          - Added the dinosaur from my newer coop mod (with colors changed)
          - Added more variants of blue chickens and void chickens in natural colors
          - Changed the dark brown variant colors
          - Changed wing animation on the back-facing chicken sprites
          - Changed void chicken slightly to differentiate it from the brahma sprite
          - Changed all rabbit sprites to recolors of the rabbits from my newer coop mod, since they were already very similar
          - Changed the side view, front view, and bill of the duck
          - Changed the mallard ducks to use the lighter brown
